$Comment: The lights a player places: torches, lanterns, lamps and braziers. The Thrift and Building families take them, though thrift spares only a light that stands on its own: one that rests on a wall or a floor and pops off when it goes (every torch, most lanterns) is never spared. A block joins any family by naming it in its own item Tags under ZigBlockFamily, so another mod opts its lights in from its own files. Retune or switch it off by id in mods/ziggfreedcommon/block-families.json.
